Tata's D&D Character Keeper

This page needs JavaScript, so it can't run inside a file preview.

iPhone / iPad: the Files app only previews HTML files and never runs their scripts. Open the app from a web address in Safari instead (the file hosted on any web space), then tap Share → Add to Home Screen so it opens like an app and keeps your characters.

PC / Android: open the file in a browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari).
